queries.name: gate4_physical_link_state
queries.sql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN COL_LENGTH(
        'dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente',
        'PersonaID'
    ) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS persona_id_exists,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM sys.foreign_keys
        WHERE parent_object_id =
              OBJECT_ID('dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente')
          AND name =
              'FK_RH_Colaboradores_Expediente_GobiernoPersona'
    ) AS persona_fk_exists,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM sys.indexes
        WHERE object_id =
              OBJECT_ID('dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente')
          AND name =
              'IX_RH_Colaboradores_Expediente_PersonaID'
    ) AS persona_index_exists;

queries.name: backfill_population_baseline
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_colaboradores,
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN CURP IS NOT NULL
         AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CURP)) <> ''
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS con_curp,
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN RFC IS NOT NULL
         AND LTRIM(RTRIM(RFC)) <> ''
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS con_rfc,
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN (CURP IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CURP)) = '')
         AND (RFC IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(RFC)) = '')
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS sin_curp_y_rfc,
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN PersonaID IS NOT NULL
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS ya_vinculados
FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente;

queries.name: backfill_auto_cohort_curp
queries.sql:
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS auto_curp
FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente c
WHERE c.PersonaID IS NULL
  AND c.CURP IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CURP)) <> ''
  AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CURP))) = 18
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente x
      WHERE x.ColaboradorID <> c.ColaboradorID
        AND x.CURP = c.CURP
  );

queries.name: backfill_auto_cohort_rfc_without_curp
queries.sql:
SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS auto_rfc_only
FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente c
WHERE c.PersonaID IS NULL
  AND (c.CURP IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(c.CURP)) = '')
  AND c.RFC IS NOT NULL
  AND LTRIM(RTRIM(c.RFC)) <> ''
  AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.RFC))) IN (12,13)
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente x
      WHERE x.ColaboradorID <> c.ColaboradorID
        AND x.RFC = c.RFC
  );

queries.name: identifier_format_quality
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN CURP IS NOT NULL
         AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CURP)) <> ''
         AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(CURP))) <> 18
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS curp_longitud_invalida,
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN RFC IS NOT NULL
         AND LTRIM(RTRIM(RFC)) <> ''
         AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(RFC))) NOT IN (12,13)
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS rfc_longitud_invalida
FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente;

queries.name: secondary_identity_duplicate_groups
queries.sql:
WITH numero AS (
    SELECT NumeroEmpleado
    FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente
    WHERE NumeroEmpleado IS NOT NULL
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(NumeroEmpleado)) <> ''
    GROUP BY NumeroEmpleado
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
codigo AS (
    SELECT CodigoColaborador
    FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente
    WHERE CodigoColaborador IS NOT NULL
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CodigoColaborador)) <> ''
    GROUP BY CodigoColaborador
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
usuario AS (
    SELECT UsuarioID
    FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente
    WHERE UsuarioID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY UsuarioID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM numero)
        AS numero_empleado_duplicate_groups,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM codigo)
        AS codigo_colaborador_duplicate_groups,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM usuario)
        AS usuario_id_duplicate_groups;

queries.name: secondary_identity_coverage
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN NumeroEmpleado IS NOT NULL
         AND LTRIM(RTRIM(NumeroEmpleado)) <> ''
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS con_numero_empleado,
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN CodigoColaborador IS NOT NULL
         AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CodigoColaborador)) <> ''
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS con_codigo_colaborador,
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN UsuarioID IS NOT NULL
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS con_usuario_id
FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente;

queries.name: no_tax_id_name_birth_ambiguity
queries.sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        UPPER(
            LTRIM(
                RTRIM(
                    REPLACE(
                        REPLACE(
                            REPLACE(Nombre_Completo,'.',''),
                            ',',''
                        ),
                        '  ',' '
                    )
                )
            )
        ) AS nombre_norm,
        FechaNacimiento
    FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente
    WHERE (CURP IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CURP)) = '')
      AND (RFC IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(RFC)) = '')
),
grupos AS (
    SELECT
        nombre_norm,
        FechaNacimiento,
        COUNT(*) AS cantidad
    FROM base
    GROUP BY nombre_norm, FechaNacimiento
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_groups,
    COALESCE(SUM(cantidad),0) AS affected_rows
FROM grupos;

queries.name: no_tax_id_exact_name_duplicates
queries.sql:
WITH grupos AS (
    SELECT
        UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Nombre_Completo))) AS nombre_norm,
        COUNT(*) AS cantidad
    FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente
    WHERE (CURP IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CURP)) = '')
      AND (RFC IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(RFC)) = '')
    GROUP BY UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Nombre_Completo)))
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS duplicate_groups,
    COALESCE(SUM(cantidad),0) AS affected_rows
FROM grupos;

queries.name: employment_history_state
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN FechaBaja IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS con_fecha_baja,
    SUM(CASE WHEN FechaBaja IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS sin_fecha_baja,
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(
            COALESCE(Estatus_Laboral,'')
        ))) IN ('BAJA','INACTIVO','TERMINADO')
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS estatus_no_activo
FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente;

queries.name: persona_target_state

    SUM(CASE WHEN CURP IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

    SUM(CASE WHEN RFC IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        AS personas_con_rfc

queries.name: backfill_cohort_summary
queries.sql:
SELECT
    COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_pendientes,
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN PersonaID IS NULL
         AND CURP IS NOT NULL
         AND LTRIM(RTRIM(CURP)) <> ''
         AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(CURP))) = 18
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS candidatos_por_curp,
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN PersonaID IS NULL
         AND (CURP IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CURP)) = '')
         AND RFC IS NOT NULL
         AND LTRIM(RTRIM(RFC)) <> ''
         AND LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(RFC))) IN (12,13)
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS candidatos_por_rfc_sin_curp,
    SUM(CASE
        WHEN PersonaID IS NULL
         AND (CURP IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CURP)) = '')
         AND (RFC IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(RFC)) = '')
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END) AS requieren_resolucion_adicional
FROM dbo.RH_Colaboradores_Expediente;
